purpose: 流线组织分析图 — 4种流线清晰区分
prompt: Architectural circulation flow analysis diagram for a visitor center. Clean 2D plan view on whitewash (#F2EDE4) background with tile-grey (#4A4A48) building outline. 4 distinct circulation types shown as colored arrows: 散客流线 (individual visitors) as solid water-cyan #7BA3A0 lines, 团队流线 (group tours) as dashed warm-amber #D4A853 lines, 无障碍流线 (accessible route) as wide mist-green #B8C9B8 lines, 后勤流线 (service/back-of-house) as thin stone-slab #9C978E dashed lines. Flow sequence: entrance → reception → exhibition → rest area → exit. Clear directional arrows, no confusing intersections. Legend in bottom corner. Clean architectural diagram style, Song typeface title "流线组织 Circulation". No 3D, no decorative elements, no overlapping confusion.
negative_prompt: Chaotic overlapping lines, indistinguishable flow types, 3D perspective, dark background, decorative patterns, no legend
